meta.scene: 5 a.m., Amarillo. Coffee in a paper cup.
Five hundred miles of two-lane blacktop.
Her drawing is taped to the dashboard.
Wheels turning, singing along to the radio.
A flat tire outside Tulsa. Two hours lost.
Every truck stop sign: “Not far now.”
Making up time on the interstate.
Sunset in the mirror. The home exit at last.
Key change: the porch light is on.
He walks in as she blows out the candles.
